In packages/blocks/src/research/index.test.ts:
Update the tests that failed due to the new Research Summarizer feature (which turns collected research sources into BMW-compatible feedback rows with detailed summaries).
Specifically:
1. In `it("retains raw original metadata in the stream without analysis or fabricated reliability")`: update this test to expect the summarized BMW feedback row (with `[Summary]`, `Brand: "[BMW]"`, `Derivate: "F70"`, etc.) and verify that original metadata and provenance are retained.
2. In `it("completes a legitimate empty collection and retains partially collected originals")`: update the expectation for partially collected originals to expect the summarized row from `summarizeResearchDataset(raw, ...)` instead of unsummarized `researchTableRows(raw)`.
3. Run `npm test packages/blocks/src/research/index.test.ts` and ensure all 31 tests in `index.test.ts` pass!
Report back when verified.

164: /** Runs work across items with a concurrency cap, settling all or aborting promptly. */
165: export async function parallelMap<T, R>(
166:   items: readonly T[],
167:   concurrency: number,
168:   fn: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
169:   signal: AbortSignal,
170: ): Promise<R[]> {
171:   const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
172:   let next = 0;
173:   async function worker() {
174:     while (next < items.length) {
175:       if (signal.aborted) throw new Error("Operation cancelled.");
176:       const current = next++;
177:       results[current] = await fn(items[current]!, current);
178:     }
179:   }
180:   const workers = Math.max(1, Math.min(concurrency, items.length));
181:   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workers }, worker));
182:   return results;
183: }
